deliverable_codex_plan_schema_strictness.title: Harden Default Planning JSON Schema for Codex Compatibility
deliverable_codex_plan_schema_strictness.description: Make the default planning response schema strict for fixed-shape objects so Codex accepts provider-enforced validation while preserving provider-neutral Draft-07 compatibility and existing response semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: Default planning schema marks fixed-shape objects as strict with additionalProperties set to false.
Intentional map fields remain modeled as open dictionaries (workGraph.items and depRationale maps).
The response contract still allows exactly one of plan, patch, or questions.
The schema remains Draft-07 and does not introduce provider-specific keywords.
deliverable_codex_plan_schema_strictness.prompt: Implement strict-schema hardening in internal/agent/plan_defaults.go and companion tests so Codex accepts schema enforcement while Claude compatibility is preserved.

deliverable_codex_runtime_schema_enforce.title: Enforce Planning Schema at Runtime for Codex and Claude
deliverable_codex_runtime_schema_enforce.description: Extend runtime flag wiring so planning requests with metadata schema are always provider-enforced: Claude via --json-schema and Codex via --output-schema backed by per-run temp files.
acceptanceCriteria: Codex planning requests with metadata JSON schema pass --output-schema <tempfile>.
Claude planning requests with metadata JSON schema continue using --json-schema.
Temp schema files are created per run attempt and cleaned up on success or failure.
Runtime returns actionable errors when schema temp-file creation or write fails.
deliverable_codex_runtime_schema_enforce.prompt: Update runtime provider flag construction and execution lifecycle in internal/agent/runtime.go so schema enforcement is guaranteed for Codex planning without changing JSON extraction/validation behavior.

deliverable_planning_metadata_consistenc.title: Unify Planning Metadata Assembly Across CLI and TUI
deliverable_planning_metadata_consistenc.description: Replace duplicated planning metadata setup with one shared helper so all planning entrypoints (generate, refine, deps infer, and auto-refine callbacks) consistently attach schema metadata and runtime provider assignment.
acceptanceCriteria: A single shared helper is used to assemble planning metadata for CLI and TUI planning flows.
All planning entrypoints consistently include a non-empty planning JSON schema payload.
Quality auto-refine and manual revision passes keep schema metadata across subsequent refine calls.
Regression tests cover CLI and TUI metadata propagation under Codex provider selection.
deliverable_planning_metadata_consistenc.prompt: Introduce and adopt a shared planning-metadata helper, then add regression tests that prove schema metadata is present and stable across all planning request paths.

task_cli_planning_metadata_adoption.title: Adopt Shared Planning Metadata Helper in CLI Planning Flows
task_cli_planning_metadata_adoption.description: Refactor CLI planning entrypoints to use the shared metadata builder for all generate/refine/deps infer request paths, including auto-refine and manual revision loops.
acceptanceCriteria: runPlanGenerate initial request uses the shared planning metadata helper.
runPlanGenerate quality auto-refine and manual revision paths use the shared planning metadata helper.
runPlanRefine and runDepsInfer use the shared planning metadata helper.
Duplicated inline assignments of requestMeta.JSONSchema and ApplyRuntimeProvider are removed from internal/cli/agent_flows.go.
Existing CLI output behavior and prompts remain unchanged.
go test ./internal/cli -count=1 passes.
task_cli_planning_metadata_adoption.prompt: Update internal/cli/agent_flows.go to replace manual planning metadata assembly with the shared helper across generate/refine/deps infer flows, including quality auto-refine and manual revision callbacks, then run go test ./internal/cli -count=1.

task_plan_schema_additional_properties_h.title: Add Strict additionalProperties Rules to Default Plan Schema
task_plan_schema_additional_properties_h.description: Update DefaultPlanJSONSchema so fixed-shape objects are strict and Codex-compatible while preserving open-map fields and the existing response shape expected by Blackbird decoding and validation.
acceptanceCriteria: The root response object includes additionalProperties: false.
definitions.workGraph, definitions.workItem, definitions.patchOp, and definitions.question each include additionalProperties: false.
workGraph.items remains an object map whose additionalProperties points to workItem.
depRationale remains an object map whose additionalProperties value type is string.
The oneOf branch contract remains exactly plan, patch, or questions.
Schema text remains provider-neutral Draft-07 JSON Schema.
task_plan_schema_additional_properties_h.prompt: Modify internal/agent/plan_defaults.go to set additionalProperties: false on fixed-shape objects, explicitly preserve map-field exceptions for workGraph.items and depRationale, and keep existing response semantics unchanged. Validate completion by running go test ./internal/agent -count=1 and confirming the emitted schema is still valid Draft-07 JSON.

task_plan_schema_hardening_tests.title: Add Schema-Structure Tests for Strictness and Map Exceptions
task_plan_schema_hardening_tests.description: Strengthen plan default tests so schema strictness and intentional map exceptions are asserted structurally, preventing regressions that would break Codex schema acceptance.
acceptanceCriteria: internal/agent/plan_defaults_test.go validates the emitted schema JSON is parseable.
Tests assert additionalProperties: false on fixed-shape objects (root, workGraph, workItem, patchOp, question).
Tests assert workGraph.items and depRationale remain additionalProperties maps.
Tests assert oneOf continues to require exactly one of plan, patch, or questions.
go test ./internal/agent -count=1 passes.
task_plan_schema_hardening_tests.prompt: In internal/agent/plan_defaults_test.go, parse DefaultPlanJSONSchema into structured JSON and add explicit assertions that root, workGraph, workItem, patchOp, and question each set additionalProperties to false. Add explicit assertions that workGraph.items and depRationale remain typed additionalProperties maps, and assert oneOf has exactly three branches requiring plan, patch, or questions. Done when go test ./internal/agent -count=1 passes with all tests green.

task_planning_metadata_helper.title: Create Shared Planning Metadata Builder
task_planning_metadata_helper.description: Introduce one shared helper that builds planning metadata by combining caller metadata, default planning schema, and runtime provider assignment. This removes duplicated per-callsite setup and prevents CLI/TUI drift.
acceptanceCriteria: A shared helper exists (for example in internal/plangen or internal/agent) for planning metadata assembly.
Helper guarantees non-empty JSONSchema using agent.DefaultPlanJSONSchema when caller does not provide one.
Helper applies runtime provider fallback when metadata provider is empty.
Helper preserves caller-provided model/maxTokens/temperature/responseFormat values.
Unit tests cover codex runtime, claude runtime, and pre-populated metadata override behavior.
go test ./internal/plangen ./internal/agent -count=1 passes.
task_planning_metadata_helper.prompt: Add a reusable planning metadata helper and tests so both CLI and TUI can call one API for schema + provider setup instead of manually assigning JSONSchema and ApplyRuntimeProvider at each planning callsite.

task_planning_metadata_regression_tests.title: Add CLI/TUI Regression Tests for Planning Schema Metadata Propagation
task_planning_metadata_regression_tests.description: Add coverage that captures outgoing planning requests and asserts schema metadata is always present for Codex runs across CLI and TUI entrypoints, including quality auto-refine follow-up requests.
acceptanceCriteria: CLI tests assert plan generate, plan refine, and deps infer requests include non-empty metadata.jsonSchema when provider resolves to codex.
CLI tests assert quality auto-refine or manual revision follow-up refine requests keep schema metadata and provider assignment.
TUI tests assert in-process generate/refine planning requests include non-empty metadata.jsonSchema when provider resolves to codex.
Regression checks fail if any Codex planning path sends empty schema metadata.
go test ./internal/cli ./internal/tui ./internal/plangen -count=1 passes.
task_planning_metadata_regression_tests.prompt: Add targeted request-capture tests in internal/cli and internal/tui that validate schema metadata propagation for codex provider across initial and follow-up planning requests, then run go test ./internal/cli ./internal/tui ./internal/plangen -count=1.

task_runtime_codex_output_schema_tempfil.title: Wire Codex --output-schema Using Per-Run Temp Files
task_runtime_codex_output_schema_tempfil.description: Enhance runtime execution so Codex receives schema enforcement through --output-schema with a temp file generated from metadata JSONSchema. Keep Claude behavior intact and preserve existing single-object stdout parse flow.
acceptanceCriteria: When provider is codex and metadata JSONSchema is non-empty, runtime writes schema content to a temp file and passes --output-schema <path>.
When provider is claude and metadata JSONSchema is non-empty, runtime continues to pass --json-schema unchanged.
Runtime does not force Codex --json stream mode in planning paths.
Temp schema files are cleaned up after command execution for both success and error outcomes.
Schema temp-file creation/write failures return RuntimeError with actionable context.
JSON extraction, DecodeResponse, and ValidateResponse flow remains unchanged.
task_runtime_codex_output_schema_tempfil.prompt: Update internal/agent/runtime.go to materialize metadata JSONSchema into a temp file for Codex runs, append --output-schema safely in both shell and non-shell execution paths, ensure cleanup via deferred removal, and preserve existing decode/validation behavior.

task_runtime_codex_output_schema_tests.title: Add Runtime Tests for Provider Schema Flags and Temp-File Cleanup
task_runtime_codex_output_schema_tests.description: Add focused runtime tests that verify provider-specific schema flag behavior and temp-file lifecycle guarantees for Codex schema enforcement.
acceptanceCriteria: Runtime tests verify claude + JSONSchema emits --json-schema and not --output-schema.
Runtime tests verify codex + JSONSchema emits --output-schema with a readable temp-file path.
Runtime tests verify codex without JSONSchema does not emit --output-schema.
Runtime tests verify temp schema files are removed after run completion.
Runtime tests cover failure paths when schema temp file cannot be created or written.
go test ./internal/agent -count=1 passes.
task_runtime_codex_output_schema_tests.prompt: In internal/agent/runtime_test.go, add table-driven tests that assert: claude + JSONSchema emits --json-schema and not --output-schema; codex + JSONSchema emits --output-schema with a readable temp schema file path; and codex without JSONSchema emits no --output-schema. Add tests that verify temp schema files are removed after successful and failing runs, and that temp-file create/write failures return RuntimeError with actionable context. Done when go test ./internal/agent -count=1 passes.

task_tui_planning_metadata_adoption.title: Adopt Shared Planning Metadata Helper in TUI Planning Flows
task_tui_planning_metadata_adoption.description: Refactor TUI in-process planning actions to use the shared metadata helper for generate/refine and quality auto-refine callback paths so schema behavior matches CLI.
acceptanceCriteria: GeneratePlanInMemory and GeneratePlanInMemoryWithAnswers use the shared planning metadata helper.
RefinePlanInMemory and RefinePlanInMemoryWithAnswers use the shared planning metadata helper.
runGeneratedPlanQualityGate passes metadata assembled through the shared helper to each refine callback.
Duplicated inline schema/provider metadata setup is removed from internal/tui/action_wrappers.go.
Question handling and failure behavior are unchanged.
go test ./internal/tui -count=1 passes.
task_tui_planning_metadata_adoption.prompt: Update internal/tui/action_wrappers.go to centralize planning metadata assembly via the shared helper for generate/refine and quality auto-refine requests, while preserving existing question/error semantics and passing go test ./internal/tui -count=1.
